title: Network packet loss between hosts
symptoms: Connection reset by peer and read timeouts between services. Interface eth0 shows rising rx_errors and dropped packets.
root_cause: A faulty NIC, cable, switch port, or an overloaded network link.
impact: Random timeouts and retries across services.
fix_steps: Run mtr between the affected hosts to find where loss happens.
Check interface counters with ip -s link.
Move the workload off the bad host or link.
prevention: Monitor interface errors and packet loss.
